thread:
Kira: Heads up — got a note from Enterprise Sales: a competitor launched a tiny low-latency model targeted at chat widgets, customers are asking for parity on a ‘lite’ offering.
Dan: Do we have telemetry showing churn/requests on small-context workloads? how many customers would this unblock?
Maria: A couple of pilots (two fintechs) explicitly asked for < 50ms token latency and lower cost for short prompts. They’re willing to trade down quality.
Alex: Engineering note — we can ship a low-cost pathway by adding a routing policy to map short requests to a quantized 7B variant + tiny KV cache. ~2–3w if we scope for minimal config & no new UX.
Sasha: Design: we’ll need a simple checkbox in the console and a concise copy explaining quality tradeoffs. Also want a way for users to opt-out of fallback routing.
Kira: Proposed scope: (1) routing rule by token-length + tenant flag, (2) quantized 7B model variant, (3) console toggle + minimal UX copy, (4) launch criteria: perf SLO and regression guard rails. Keep telemetry hooks.
Dan: Prioritize: must-have = routing + ops fallback. Nice-to-have = advanced telemetry + per-route cost breakdown. Suggest plan: canary to 3 customers first.
Alex: Ops checklist: model variant build, inference profile for 32/64 token bursts, fallback to full model on hallucination confidence. We need an automatic rollback if quality drop > 5% on eval prompts.
Maria: Sales: for pilots we can trade a short pilot SLA for early access if we hit latency target. Need clear messaging on accuracy.
Sasha: UX mock note: inline tooltip explaining "Lite mode lowers cost but may omit details". Also need an API param for programmatic control.
Kira: Risk callouts: (A) fragmentation of routing logic creating support burden, (B) telemetry blindspots if we don’t tag routed requests, (C) potential cannibalization of Dedicated tiers.
Dan: Mitigations: tag all routed requests, add an internal debug view, and cap rollout to hosted customers first. Product owner for this slice?
Kira: I’ll take ownership for product. Alex + Eng-Platform to estimate effort today. Sasha to produce copy + API UX by EOD Tuesday. Maria to line up 2 pilot customers.
Alex: Quick estimate: 8 dev days + 3 infra days + 2 QA days for minimal shipping path. Can compress if we cut the rollback eval to a smoke check.
Kira: Launch criteria (final): 1) median token latency for 32-token prompts < 60ms, 2) cost per request reduced by >= 40% for lite path, 3) regression test suite shows < 5% quality delta on shortlisted prompts, 4) telemetry tags present and dashboards created.
product-bot: New RFC created: https://redwood/secure/rfcs/479-lite-routing — assigned Kira, reviewers Dan/Alex.
Maria: Can we get an FAQ stub for Sales before canary? customers ask about data isolation too.
Sasha: Will add a short FAQ and consent language for keys/data flows.
Dan: OK — schedule an hour sync tomorrow to finalize rollout plan. If we keep scope tight this is a realistic 3-week ship for hosted-only.
Kira: Thanks — syncing tomorrow 10am. If anyone has objections to scope, say it now or bring to the meeting. :thumbsup:
Alex: No objections from eng, :rocket:
Maria: 👍 ready to coordinate pilots
Sasha: mock links incoming before EOD Tuesday
Kira: Closing thread — owner Kira, next steps in RFC.
